dynamic_line.yes: The approach is safer now.  Traders can get to our doors without passing that pack.  For bigger threats farther out, talk to the Old Guard representative.

no.yes: Milton Lang.  I run security for the center.  We've got the back bay under control.  What do you need?
no.no: Milton Lang.  I run security for the center.  Keep civil and stay out of the sealed bay unless we have business there.

responses.text: Do you need help with security?
About the work you gave me…
I have equipment for the guards.
How did you end up running security?
What should I know while I'm here?
I'll let you get back to it.

dynamic_line: I worked nights at a distribution warehouse.  Kept track of who came through the loading dock and broke up the odd fight over a parking space.  Here I started taking the shifts nobody wanted.  After we sealed the bay, people started coming to me to see who was on watch.  Eventually I just took over the roster.

responses.text: Can I ask you something else?

dynamic_line: Keep the hallways clear, especially near the doors.  If someone gets hurt or starts acting strange, get a guard.  We've had people try to handle it quietly for a friend's sake.  That never ends well.

description: Clear out the barricaded back area in the refugee center and lay the former leader of the Free Merchants to rest, in exchange for the local currency: Free Merchant certified notes.

dialogue.offer: I need someone to clear out the dead in the back bay.  Fearful of going outside during the first days of the Cataclysm we ended up throwing our dead and the zombies we managed to kill in the sealed back bay.  Our promising leader at the time even fell… he turned into something different.  Kill all of them and make sure they won't bother us again.  We can't pay much, besides some of our own internal money which isn't good for that much yet, but it would help us to reclaim the bay.
dialogue.accepted: Please be careful, we don't need any more deaths.
dialogue.rejected: Come back if you change your mind.  We need that bay secured.
dialogue.advice: If you can, get a friend or two to help you.
dialogue.inquire: Will they be bothering us any longer?
dialogue.success: Thank you, having that big of a threat close to home was nerve wracking.  Here's some of our local certified notes, we've been paying these to our workers in exchange for supplies.  They're getting some value in the center as a trade item, I'm afraid they're all we have to spare at the moment.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dynamic_line: I'll log each piece as it comes in.  Two radios and two lights, one of each for each post.

description: Bring Milton Lang two two-way radios and two flashlights for the Refugee Center guards.

dialogue.describe: I need equipment for the guards.
dialogue.offer: Now that the bay's clear, I can split the night watch between the doors.  I need two working two-way radios so the guards can talk, and two flashlights so they can see what they're talking about.  Ten Certified Notes for the lot.
dialogue.accepted: One radio and one light for each post.  Bring them to me as you find them.
dialogue.rejected: We'll keep sending someone down the hall with messages.
dialogue.advice: Try electronics stores for the radios.  Check hardware stores or houses for the flashlights.
dialogue.inquire: Did you find both radios and both flashlights?
dialogue.success: That's enough for both posts.  I'll run a radio check at shift change.
dialogue.success_lie: I need enough to equip both posts.
dialogue.failure: I'll keep a runner on the roster.

description: Eliminate the zombies in the marked field near the Refugee Center so scavengers and traders can reach it safely.

dialogue.describe: The watch spotted a few dead out in the field.
dialogue.offer: One of the guards called in a small pack in a field near the center.  They're close enough to catch a trader coming in with a load.  Clear the pack and I'll pay you thirty Certified Notes.
dialogue.accepted: I've marked the field on your map.  I'll keep the guards on the doors.
dialogue.rejected: I'll tell the watch to warn anyone headed that way.
dialogue.advice: There's room to move in the field.  Use it to draw them apart.
dialogue.success: Good.  The scavengers and traders have a safer way in now.  If you're looking to deal with threats farther out, ask the Old Guard representative.
dialogue.success_lie: I need the whole pack cleared.
dialogue.failure: I'll warn people to give that field a wide berth.

dynamic_line: Every time I ask for an incident report, somebody's lost a pen.  Bring me four pens.  Two Certified Notes if it gets me through a shift without hearing that excuse.

description: Bring Milton Lang four pens so the guards can write their incident reports.

dialogue.offer: Every time I ask for an incident report, somebody's lost a pen.  Bring me four pens.  Two Certified Notes if it gets me through a shift without hearing that excuse.
dialogue.accepted: I'll put the forms out.  They've never managed to lose those.
dialogue.rejected: I'll see if anyone remembers how to borrow one.
dialogue.advice: Check desks.  That's where ours are supposed to be.
dialogue.success: Four pens.  I'll see how long it takes them to run out of paper.
dialogue.success_lie: Four pens.  I can count them myself.
dialogue.failure: I'll keep taking the reports out loud.
